taskDescription: Match each KOH microscopy appearance (left) to the clinical presentation caused by that pathogen (right).

cards.imageAlt: KOH mount at 40x showing long, branching, septate hyphae characteristic of dermatophyte infection
cards.matchAlt: Tinea corporis: annular lesion with raised scaly advancing margin and central clearing

cards.imageAlt: KOH mount at 40x showing pseudohyphae with budding yeast cells characteristic of Candida
cards.matchAlt: Cutaneous candidiasis: red macerated patch in a skin fold with satellite pustules

cards.imageAlt: KOH mount at 40x showing short curved hyphae with clustered round spores — the spaghetti and meatballs pattern of Malassezia furfur
cards.matchAlt: Pityriasis versicolor: hypo- and hyperpigmented macules with fine scaling on the upper trunk
